# pub title
title: "Asymmetric Gaming Further Apart: Effects of World and Goal Sharing on Cooperative Play"

# publication image

  alt-text: "A screenshot of the game used in the paper. It shows the avatars of two players playing in a desert world, with hordes of enemies approaching." # provide a short description for the image #a11y

# short description of the publication
description: "Asymmetric game design can foster rich social experiences by assigning players distinct, interdependent roles. Yet, it remains unclear how increasing asymmetry (e.g., by placing players in different environments) affects social interaction. We present a mixed-methods study with 88 participants investigating how sharing (or not sharing) a virtual world and a goal shapes social behavior and player perceptions in asymmetric cooperative games. Our findings show that distinct worlds and goals introduce friction while enabling new forms of cooperation. We conclude with design considerations for designing highly asymmetric experiences that preserve social connection."
